cases.stimulus: IsOS schema-2 selected leaf has matching revision, generation, and listed eos/graph.json bytes
cases.expect: EOS publishes saved active revision distinct from projection SHA; one managed write can enter admission

cases.stimulus: Selected IsOS v2 profile without verifier, verifier with non-v2 profile, or managed manifest missing, duplicate EOS entry, symlink, path escape, digest mismatch, or wrong run/revision
cases.expect: Startup fails before listener, ready event, adapter construction or release; no fallback to standalone and no draft bytes changed

cases.stimulus: Known legacy 1.0.0 or standalone non-v2 mock profile has neither verifier handoff nor verified schema-2 manifest, optionally with --run-id correlation
cases.expect: Read/discovery and migration remain available; production actuator Submit fails closed even when --run-id was supplied

cases.stimulus: No or malformed Bearer grant on Submit/Get/Watch/Cancel, or missing/altered client grant file after EOS readiness
cases.expect: UNAUTHENTICATED for affected requests; listener readiness unchanged by client file alone; no reservation, result disclosure, cancellation or adapter call

cases.stimulus: Old grant/verifier from a prior IsOS run with same saved graph revision
cases.expect: UNAUTHENTICATED or pre-ready failure; no adapter call and no old success impersonation

cases.stimulus: Egia grant requests operator-only inhibit recovery; operator grant submits gRPC movement; private primitive_typed presents egia-control
cases.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED; no inhibit clear or adapter call

cases.stimulus: Missing or malformed x-eos-active-revision on ordinary movement or controlled stop
cases.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT; zero adapter calls

cases.stimulus: Well-formed saved revision differs from active IsOS revision
cases.expect: FAILED_PRECONDITION before reservation/release; projection SHA cannot substitute

cases.stimulus: Saved draft changes while old EOS process remains active, then explicit Restart
cases.expect: Old process keeps its active revision; new process reports new saved revision; stale caller fails

cases.stimulus: Exact active primitive binding and role, valid typed arguments and future deadline
cases.expect: Exactly one Dispatcher route, one journal identity and at most one adapter release

cases.stimulus: Unknown source, multiple target, changed device target, wrong mode or kind
cases.expect: Rejected before adapter call; authored evidence wire never executes a command

cases.stimulus: NaN/infinite or out-of-range velocity, wrong frame or joint order
cases.expect: Terminal rejection or INVALID_ARGUMENT before release; no unit conversion

cases.stimulus: Fake clock advances health beyond profile stale_after_ms or health degrades
cases.expect: Movement rejected, node availability degrades, fresh valid probe restores eligibility

cases.stimulus: Fake clock advances required observation beyond stale_after_ms or marks it invalid
cases.expect: Movement rejected, read fault recorded; valid fresh observation restores eligibility

cases.stimulus: Command waits behind release gate until monotonic deadline expires
cases.expect: Terminal rejection and zero late adapter calls after gate reopens

cases.stimulus: Same run, role, revision, binding and arguments retry with same ID and new transport deadline
cases.expect: Retained result; deadline excluded from signature; adapter release count remains one

cases.stimulus: Same ID changes role, saved revision, binding, target, or typed arguments
cases.expect: ALREADY_EXISTS/conflict; no second adapter release

cases.stimulus: New IsOS run reuses old command ID with same graph, role and arguments
cases.expect: ALREADY_EXISTS; old SUCCEEDED not returned as this run and no new release

cases.stimulus: Crash after durable Releasing before terminal result; EOS child restarts in same IsOS run
cases.expect: Old ID becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, GetOperation recovers it, movement inhibited, no auto-retry

cases.stimulus: Pre-release durable write fails; terminal persistence fails after possible release
cases.expect: First has zero adapter calls; second remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and never claims success

cases.stimulus: Other role calls GetOperation, WatchOperation, CancelOperation or private result for an ID
cases.expect: PERMISSION_DENIED; no result leak, no cancellation; same role after same-run restart may recover

cases.stimulus: Movement lane saturated and authenticated safety.estop has stale/missing revision
cases.expect: Reserved emergency lane admits once; missing grant still UNAUTHENTICATED

cases.stimulus: RobotStop inhibit active: EGIA or unmarked operator tries recovery; marked operator uses fresh ID
cases.expect: Only marked operator snapshots old/current target union; no clear until all confirmed; emergency latch unchanged

cases.stimulus: Private manual, primitive, skill_execute, skill_result, dispatch, stop, manual_stop, cancel, result, skill_cancel, old primitive_typed header, browser shutdown, or wrong-UID private shutdown
cases.expect: No production alternate actuator/cancel/result route; zero adapter release; owner-only private shutdown accepted while bridge/wrong-UID shutdown denied; R06 still owns MuJoCo stop ordering

cases.stimulus: Evidence queue is full, capped or drops a camera/state event while a command submits
cases.expect: Evidence gap visible; command and fixed safety route are neither capped nor silently dropped
